title: Higher and lower sounds
summary: Listen to how a string changes its sound.

steps.title: Higher and lower sounds
steps.body:
A higher sound feels thinner; a lower sound feels deeper. For otherwise similar strings, a thicker string sounds lower, a tighter string sounds higher, and a shorter vibrating length sounds higher. Change one thing at a time when comparing.

**Why it matters:** These three ideas explain how the controls and your hands change a guitar sound. Do not tighten a string for this experiment; just listen.

steps.title: Look and listen
steps.body: Hear the two lit E sounds: string 6 is thick and low; string 1 is thin and high. The screen makes this comparison without adjusting your guitar.

items.prompt: For otherwise similar strings, what happens when a string gets tighter?

steps.title: Take your time
steps.body: Pluck the thickest and thinnest open strings softly, one at a time. Listen for the difference. Do not turn a peg or pull a string.
